cas.description: CAS journal zones (upgraded edition) for the Computer Science category — Top journals and zones at a glance
cas.stats: {total} journals · {z1} in Zone 1 · {top} Top · {matched} match current filters
cas.sourceNote: Data from a community-maintained version of the official CAS journal zone site (fenqubiao.com, upgraded edition). Zones and ranks reflect the release snapshot; always consult the official latest release. Each subject line lists a JCR subject with that subject's own zone and rank; the badge at the row's end (e.g. Zone 1) and Top describe the journal's main-category zone and main-category Top status — a different level, so the numbers can differ.
